doc.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010

title: Meeting her husband Rick at college
summary: She met Rick in college when she was twenty; together thirteen years.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: You and Rick have a very romantic story. You’ve talked about meeting him and he was pursuing you, and I guess it was a mutual pursuance. © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-

Oh it was all him. He chased me as I had never been chased by a boy. Oh yeah, just chased. Although it’s not like I was resisting. We met in college when we were both 20. I was a junior and he was a freshman. He had taken two years off before starting school because he was just playing constantly. He had a thousand gigs. And that’s as much of an education for a jazz musician as theory class. Both things are incredibly important. So we met at the beginning of the school year and yeah, that was it, boy, that was it. And now we’ve been together for 13 years.
